name: uml-js
description: A UML toolkit and web modeler

scripts.all: npm run build && npm run open
scripts.build: rollup -c --bundleConfigAsCjs && node ../../tools/js/scope-css.mjs --package node_modules/diagram-js --scope "(:has(> .djs-parent):not(.bjs-container)) to (:scope > :not(.djs-parent))" --header resources/diagram-js-header.css --out ../src/main/webapp/style/umljs/diagram-js.css assets/diagram-js.css
